title: The recording studio setting
summary: He recalls the large upstairs room and Columbia's New York crew but not how many microphones.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: I was gonna ask you, you say you made those records in the God Show building. I guess it would be upstairs somewhere. Yes, it was upstairs somewhere.
You don't remember just whereabouts upstairs?
Oh no, I wouldn't know none.
Was it a large room? It was a large room. Do you remember how many microphones they used?
You don't remember seeing a mic in front of your face or anything?
I know they had a mic over there. I wouldn't know how many mics they had around the house. You don't remember seeing what?
Yeah. That would be a Chicago outfit that came down here with? Was it Columbus? I don't remember if they were. New York, I guess. New York.
